001package pkg_commands;
002
003import java.util.HashMap;
004
005/**
006 * Maintains the fixed vocabulary of primary commands understood by the game.
007 *
008 * <p>Each entry maps a command word to the concrete {@link Command} that executes it.
009 *
010 * @author Michael Kolling and David J. Barnes + D. Bureau
011 * @version 2008.03.30 + 2019.09.25
012 */
013public class CommandWords {
014    /** All valid command objects mapped by their command word. */
015    private HashMap<String, Command> aCommands;
016
017    /** Creates a CommandWords object containing all valid commands. */
018    public CommandWords() {
019        this.aCommands = new HashMap<String, Command>();
020        this.aCommands.put("go", new GoCommand());
021        this.aCommands.put("help", new HelpCommand());
022        this.aCommands.put("quit", new QuitCommand());
023        this.aCommands.put("look", new LookCommand());
024        this.aCommands.put("cashin", new CashinCommand());
025        this.aCommands.put("back", new BackCommand());
026        this.aCommands.put("test", new TestCommand());
027        this.aCommands.put("alea", new AleaCommand());
028        this.aCommands.put("battle", new BattleCommand());
029        this.aCommands.put("name", new NameCommand());
030        this.aCommands.put("take", new TakeCommand());
031        this.aCommands.put("drop", new DropCommand());
032        this.aCommands.put("inventory", new InventoryCommand());
033        this.aCommands.put("save", new SaveCommand());
034        this.aCommands.put("load", new LoadCommand());
035    } // CommandWords()
036
037    /**
038     * Given a command word, finds and returns the matching command object.
039     *
040     * @param pWord the command word to look up
041     * @return the matching command object, or {@code null}
042     */
043    public Command get(final String pWord) {
044        return this.aCommands.get(pWord);
045    } // get()
046
047    /**
048     * Tests membership of {@code pString} in the internal command table (case-sensitive).
049     *
050     * @param pString candidate verb, usually lower-case
051     * @return {@code true} if {@code pString} is a known command word
052     */
053    public boolean isCommand(final String pString) {
054        return this.aCommands.containsKey(pString);
055    } // isCommand()
056
057    /**
058     * Builds a single string listing every valid command, separated by spaces.
059     *
060     * @return space-delimited command list for help output
061     */
062    public String getCommandList() {
063        String vCommandList = "";
064        for (String vCommand : this.aCommands.keySet()) {
065            vCommandList += vCommand + " ";
066    }
067        return vCommandList;
068    } // getCommandList()
069} // CommandWords
